﻿# genui_gen_v4_compact

You are a GenUICraft generator.
Convert the RESPONSE text into valid GenUICraft v0.9 server-to-client messages.

RESPONSE:
FY2023 Quarterly Revenue Analysis

Assumptions:
- All monetary values are in thousands of US Dollars (e.g., 45k = $45,000).
- The quarters are sequential for the purpose of calculating growth (Q1 -> Q2 -> Q3 -> Q4).

Summary
The fourth quarter (Q4) of FY2023 had the highest total revenue growth, with an increase of $18,000 over the third quarter (Q3). Software consistently remained the highest-earning product line throughout the year, showing strong and steady growth each quarter.

Revenue Breakdown by Quarter (in thousands USD)
This table provides the raw data and totals for each quarter.

| Quarter | Software | Hardware | Services | Total Revenue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Q1 2023 | $45 | $30 | $20 | $95 |
| Q2 2023 | $48 | $28 | $22 | $98 |
| Q3 2023 | $52 | $35 | $25 | $112 |
| Q4 2023 | $60 | $40 | $30 | $130 |

Grouped Bar Chart Data
This data can be used to render a grouped bar chart visualizing the quarterly performance of each product line.

- Chart Title: FY2023 Quarterly Revenue by Product Line
- Chart Type: Grouped Bar Chart
- X-Axis Label: Fiscal Quarter
- Y-Axis Label: Revenue (in thousands USD)
- Categories (X-Axis): [Q1 2023, Q2 2023, Q3 2023, Q4 2023]
- Series 1 (Software):
  - Color: #4A90E2
  - Data: [45, 48, 52, 60]
- Series 2 (Hardware):
  - Color: #F5A623
  - Data: [30, 28, 35, 40]
- Series 3 (Services):
  - Color: #7ED321
  - Data: [20, 22, 25, 30]

Quarter-over-Quarter Growth Analysis
The table below details the total revenue growth from one quarter to the next.

| Period | Total Revenue | Quarter-over-Quarter Growth |
|---|---|---|
| Q1 2023 | $95k | - |
| Q2 2023 | $98k | +$3k |
| Q3 2023 | $112k | +$14k |
| Q4 2023 | $130k | +$18k |

Conclusion
The analysis confirms that the growth from **Q3 to Q4 was the highest** for the fiscal year, both in absolute terms (+$18k) and percentage terms (+16.1%).

Quick Actions:
[Button: Export Full Data as CSV]
[Button: Create Q1 2024 Forecast]
[Button: View Product Line Profitability Report]

Output contract:
- Output ONLY a JSON array (no markdown, no prose).
- Each array item must be one v0.9 message object.
- Allowed message types only: `createSurface`, `updateComponents`, `updateDataModel`, `deleteSurface`.
- Add `createSurface` before any updates.
- `createSurface.catalogId` must be `https://genui.local/specification/v0_9/standard_catalog.json`.
- Include exactly one `updateComponents` message with a complete component set.
- In that set, include exactly one component with `id: "root"` as tree root.
- Component ids must be unique; all child references must resolve.
- Use only catalog-supported components and properties.

Component guidance:
- Prefer structured UI over text dumps.
- Use `Card`, `Row`, `Column`, `List`, `Tabs`, `Divider`, `Button` where appropriate.
- Convert action-like links/"Quick Actions" to `Button` with `action.functionCall.call = "openUrl"`.
- Preserve key content (assumptions, options, comparisons, totals, sources) without hallucination.
- If dynamic rows are useful, use `updateDataModel` + template children binding.

Assets and URLs:
- For media, use only local asset paths that start with `/`.
- Never output remote image/icon URLs.
- For web actions, `openUrl` targets may be remote URLs.

Validation reminders:
- `version` must be `"v0.9"` on every message.
- `updateComponents.components` must be a non-empty array.
- Keep JSON strictly valid.
